entities.name: Johann Jakob, Count of Bronckhorst and Anholt
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann Jakob von Bronckhorst, named Graf Anholt, was Count of Bronckhorst-Batenburg. He was a field marshal in the Holy Roman Empire during the Thirty Years' War.
